body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature or unsecured object within 6 units. On a success, move it up to 2 units.

surges.html: Increase the movement from this Action by 1 unit.
Choose one additional unsecured object within 2 units of the first; manipulate or move it as part of this Action.

rider.title: PROJECTION — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, increase its range by 2 units.
